title: Rate Committee Table of Rounding Applied to Assembled Certificate of Deposit Rates
content:
Where a new term of a certificate of the Certificates of Deposit line is recorded, the hundredth of a percentage point at which the assembled rate settles is graded by the owner's card spending.

## 1. The grades

The rounding of the assembled rate is graded by what the owner has charged to a Piedmont Crescent card in the twelve months before the day the new term is recorded: at or above 6000.00 USD the assembled rate is rounded up to the next hundredth of a percentage point; at or above 2500.00 USD but below 6000.00 USD it is rounded to the nearest hundredth with a half rounded up; below 2500.00 USD it is rounded down to the hundredth.

The card whose purchases are counted is an account of the bank's Personal Credit Cards line belonging to the owner, and the sum counted is what has been charged to it over the twelve months ending on the day the new term is recorded.

## 2. The grades as a table

| Charged to a Piedmont Crescent card in those twelve months | The assembled rate settles |
|---|---|
| 6000.00 USD or more | rounded up to the next hundredth of a percentage point |
| at least 2500.00 USD, below 6000.00 USD | rounded to the nearest hundredth, a half rounded up |
| below 2500.00 USD | rounded down to the hundredth |

Both figures are floors. Spending of exactly 6000.00 USD takes the first grade; spending of exactly 2500.00 USD takes the second.

## 3. What the three grades do to one assembled rate

Take an assembled rate of 3.9425 percent.

| Grade | Result |
|---|---|
| rounded up to the next hundredth | 3.95 percent |
| rounded to the nearest hundredth, a half rounded up | 3.94 percent |
| rounded down to the hundredth | 3.94 percent |

Take instead an assembled rate of 3.9450 percent.

| Grade | Result |
|---|---|
| rounded up to the next hundredth | 3.95 percent |
| rounded to the nearest hundredth, a half rounded up | 3.95 percent |
| rounded down to the hundredth | 3.94 percent |

An assembled rate already exact to the hundredth, say 4.02 percent, settles at 4.02 percent under all three grades, there being nothing to round away or up to.

## 4. Basis Q&A

**Over what period is the spending measured?** The twelve months before the day the new term is recorded, not the term that has ended and not a calendar year.

**Does the grade change the figures that were added together?** No. The grade settles only the hundredth at which the assembled sum comes to rest.
